Section 2 of Executive Order 10804 (signed February 12, 1959; 24 FR 1147; held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10804.txt) revoked Executive Order 9721, whose paragraph 3(a) this order modified for Paul D. Miles, except for employees serving with an international organization on the date of enactment of the Federal Employees International Organization Service Act who do not elect its coverage and for rights and benefits vested before that date. This dossier has no evidence record for Executive Order 10804, so the 1959 event cannot be recorded as a later event or source note.

Whether anything of this order survived the 1959 revocation is not shown by any held source: as amended by Executive Order 10415, the order gave Miles reemployment rights only if his service with the International Frequency Registration Board ended without prejudice on or before December 31, 1953, and no held source shows whether it did, so it is not established whether his modified right vested (and was saved in 1959) or lapsed. A first end in 1986 by Executive Order 12553 cannot be claimed until a source supplement adds Executive Order 10804 and that question is resolved or bounded from evidence.
